subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should OpenClaw silently exclude a workspace subtree for valid sub-4 MiB ignore files that exceed the new 20,000-rule, 16 KiB-rule, or aggregate-character budgets?
rationale: The bounds alter existing workspace and skill discovery rather than merely limiting a file read; the correct compatibility/security tradeoff is a core policy choice.

options.title: Keep this PR to bounded reads
options.body: Retain the 4 MiB read limit and defer rule-count and pattern-complexity denial behavior to a separately scoped, approved hardening proposal.

options.title: Adopt the full budget policy
options.body: Approve all four fail-closed thresholds as scanner policy, add visible diagnostics and user-facing documentation, and refresh proof on the exact head.
